name: 29006 · Batesburg, SC
findings: ZIP 29006 (Batesburg) has 24 nonprofit organizations. 10 of them (42%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 8 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (50% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 29006 (Batesburg) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
